name: memo-campus
description: MÉMO CAMPUS — Plateforme EdTech intelligente (Web + Android + API)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @memo/shared && npm run build -w @memo/api && npm run build -w @memo/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @memo/api && npm run test -w @memo/shared
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w @memo/shared typecheck && npm run -w @memo/api typecheck && npm run -w @memo/web typecheck
